text_blocks.snippet: Medications for congestive heart failure (CHF) include ACE inhibitors, ARBs, beta-blockers, diuretics, and aldosterone antagonists. These medications help manage symptoms, improve heart function, and reduce the risk of hospitalization. Specific drugs like digoxin, hydralazine with nitrate, and ivabradine may also be used in certain cases.
